startups.name: A. Baggenstos
startups.about: IT services company in Wallisellen near Zurich, founded in 1925, providing cloud, hybrid and on-premise infrastructure, managed services, outsourcing and Microsoft solutions for Swiss businesses.

startups.name: Aequitec AG
startups.about: Zurich-based platform for digital share registers and shareholder meetings, handling voting, proxies, share transfers and capital increases for private and listed companies.

startups.name: AgenturScout
startups.about: Swiss platform that helps companies find and compare marketing, communication and web agencies through a curated, data-based matching process.

startups.name: Algomia GmbH
startups.about: Aarau-based startup offering API-based optimisation AI that automates scheduling and resource allocation, such as crew scheduling for public transport operators, for B2B clients.

startups.name: Alivion AG
startups.about: ETH Zurich spin-off developing handheld gas sensors that detect volatile biomarkers in breath; its Nutrion device lets users monitor their metabolism.

startups.name: AMESCO AG
startups.about: Swiss company in Kemptthal that has developed its own wine dealcoholisation method and develops, produces and markets alcohol-free wines with selected wineries.

startups.name: armasuisse
startups.about: Swiss Federal Office for Defence Procurement within the DDPS; procures systems and equipment for the Swiss Armed Forces and runs defence science, technology and innovation programmes.

startups.name: Astrivis Technologies AG
startups.about: ETH Zurich spin-off whose software turns smartphones and tablets into 3D scanners, focusing on mobile body scanning (e.g. feet, face) for healthcare, e-commerce and other industries.

startups.name: August Manser AG
startups.about: Family-owned company in Altstätten (St. Gallen) with about 100 employees, developing and manufacturing mechanical and mechatronic systems for industrial customers.

startups.name: Awakenomy
startups.about: Startup that pitched at the HR Festival in Zurich; no further verified details about its product found.

startups.name: AWS
startups.about: Amazon's cloud computing platform offering compute, storage, database and AI services; supports startups with credits and programmes such as AWS Activate.

startups.name: AXA
startups.about: Swiss subsidiary of the AXA Group providing insurance and occupational pension solutions for private customers and companies.

startups.name: beeaccounting
startups.about: Fiduciary firm in Bassersdorf (Zurich), formerly ITS Treuhand AG, offering bookkeeping, tax advice, auditing and succession planning for companies.

startups.name: bexio
startups.about: Cloud business software for Swiss small businesses and self-employed people, covering accounting, invoicing, payroll and banking integration.

startups.name: Binabik AG
startups.about: Startup with offices in Winterthur and Turku building an agentic operating system for physical AI that lets humanoid and other robots learn tasks from small datasets.

startups.name: Borobotics AG
startups.about: Winterthur startup building an autonomous electric drilling robot that drills shallow geothermal boreholes for heat pumps in tight urban spaces.

startups.name: Brack
startups.about: Swiss online retailer selling electronics, household, office and leisure products to consumers and businesses; part of the Competec group in Mägenwil.

startups.name: Brian Study
startups.about: Zurich-based HSG spin-off whose AI-powered learning app turns course material into adaptive, gamified quizzes and lessons for universities and schools.

startups.name: Casa Refill AG
startups.about: Zurich refill store selling shampoo, conditioner, body lotion and other care products without plastic packaging; customers refill their own containers.

startups.name: CDDS
startups.about: Counter-Drone Defense Systems AG, a Schlieren (Zurich) startup developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors that neutralise hostile drones.

startups.name: Codenotch
startups.about: Coding school based in Madrid offering full-time and part-time bootcamps in web and mobile development and data science, in person and online, for career changers.

startups.name: Conda
startups.about: Swiss crowdinvesting platform based in Baar that lets private investors invest in startups and SMEs from CHF 100 per campaign; also offers white-label platforms.

startups.name: CVCoach
startups.about: Young startup (CVCoach GmbH, Münsingen BE, registered 2026) helping job seekers write and improve their CVs for job applications. Product details not verified.

startups.name: DATABIOMIX
startups.about: Schlieren-based techbio startup offering gut microbiota analysis, microbial genomics and strain-specific primer design, and developing AI-based microbiome biomarkers and companion diagnostics for researchers, clinicians and biopharma.

startups.name: DataHive
startups.about: Possibly DataHive AI, a platform where people contribute and get paid for their personal data used to train AI models; match with the exhibitor not confirmed.

startups.name: DiPriMa
startups.about: Geneva-based startup selected in 2025 for support from the Fongit cantonal innovation fund; product details not verified.

startups.name: Do it in St.Gallen
startups.about: Initiative promoting St.Gallen as a place to found and grow a business; no official page could be verified online.

startups.name: Dphi Space AG
startups.about: Lausanne startup that builds and operates shared satellites (Clustergate) hosting multiple customer payloads and offering in-orbit computing, giving companies cheaper and faster access to space.

startups.name: e-Residency – Republic of Estonia
startups.about: Estonian government programme giving non-residents a government-issued digital identity to start and run an EU-based company online.

startups.name: EM Path GmbH
startups.about: Lausanne-area hardware and software startup whose wave-imaging RF test system characterises antennas and complete wireless devices in under a second, without a traditional anechoic chamber.

startups.name: ESA BIC Switzerland
startups.about: European Space Agency business incubation centre run with ETH Zurich, giving Swiss startups with a space connection seed funding, coaching and access to ESA expertise and facilities.

startups.name: Eternal Echo AG
startups.about: Horgen (ZH) company whose registered purpose covers trade, consulting and coaching, video and film production, and data tracking services; product not verified.

startups.name: Euresearch
startups.about: Swiss information network funded by SERI that advises researchers and companies, free of charge, on finding partners and applying for EU research and innovation funding such as Horizon Europe.

startups.name: Findea
startups.about: Winterthur-based digital fiduciary providing bookkeeping, tax and payroll services through an online platform for startups and SMEs across Switzerland.

startups.name: fluidbot AG
startups.about: Gossau (SG) startup building autonomous robots that travel through drinking water pipes and collect condition data, helping water utilities detect damage and leaks early.

startups.name: Fotny
startups.about: Event photo app: hosts collect guest and photographer photos in one place, AI filters inappropriate content, and each guest finds their own photos by uploading a selfie.

startups.name: GeneSys Bio s.r.l.
startups.about: Italian diagnostics startup (Viterbo area) developing a portable AI-based system that detects pathogens and antimicrobial resistance in under 30 minutes.

startups.name: GenoGra s.r.l.
startups.about: Milan-based Politecnico di Milano spin-off offering genome-graph (pangenomics) analysis software for human, plant, animal and microbial genomics, cutting analysis time from weeks to days.

startups.name: Gisada
startups.about: Winterthur-based fragrance brand founded in 2013 that creates, produces and distributes perfumes sold in retail stores in over 90 countries.

startups.name: Helvo
startups.about: Financial platform for Swiss SMEs and founders that combines business accounts, payments, invoicing, payroll and accounting; accounts are held with partner bank Hypothekarbank Lenzburg.

startups.name: Home of Innovation
startups.about: Coworking space and startup hub of about 6,000 m2 on the former Rieter industrial site in Winterthur, offering office space, community events and support programmes for startups.

startups.name: HOOQ AG
startups.about: Winterthur startup making custom climbing shoes built from 3D scans of each customer's feet, with semi-custom and full-custom models.

startups.name: HWZ
startups.about: HWZ Hochschule für Wirtschaft Zürich, a university of applied sciences offering part-time bachelor, master and continuing education programmes in business, communication, digital business and entrepreneurship.

startups.name: Impact Hub Zürich
startups.about: Zurich branch of the global Impact Hub network, running coworking spaces, events and programmes for entrepreneurs and startups working on social and environmental impact.

startups.name: INFERCOM
startups.about: Luxembourg-based provider of sovereign AI inference-as-a-service for European companies and public agencies, running open-weight models on SambaNova hardware in German data centres via an OpenAI-compatible API.

startups.name: Innosuisse
startups.about: Swiss Innovation Agency, the federal body that funds science-based innovation projects and supports startups through coaching, certification and training programmes.

startups.name: Innoverse Technologies GmbH
startups.about: Possible match: innoverse.AI, an AI company in Villars-sur-Glâne developing artificial intelligence solutions for organisations; link to the GmbH not confirmed.

startups.name: Italian Trade Agency
startups.about: ITA (ICE), the Italian government agency that promotes Italian companies abroad and attracts foreign investment to Italy, including startup delegations at international events.

startups.name: Kanton Zürich
startups.about: Cantonal government of Zurich; its Office for Economy supports companies and startups setting up and growing in the canton.

startups.name: Kuafu
startups.about: Dübendorf startup founded in 2024 commercialising Empa research: AI-based software that helps grid operators ease congestion by using flexible loads such as e-mobility and smart buildings.

startups.name: Langrove
startups.about: Platform for building app backends: data models, endpoint code, authorization policies, workflows and AI agents.

startups.name: LEXR
startups.about: Law firm founded in Zurich that advises startups, scale-ups and tech companies on corporate, financing, commercial, IP, data protection and employment matters.

startups.name: Microsoft
startups.about: Global technology company providing cloud services (Azure), productivity software (Microsoft 365), AI tools (Copilot) and the Microsoft for Startups programme.

startups.name: MME Legal
startups.about: Swiss business law firm in Zurich and Zug combining legal, tax and compliance advice, with strong practices in fintech, blockchain and digital assets, technology, data protection and M&A.

startups.name: Monitoris AG
startups.about: Zurich-based digital fiduciary offering an AI-supported back office for self-employed people and SMEs: bookkeeping, VAT, payroll, tax returns and annual accounts, with personal accountant support.

startups.name: Nettle Circle AG
startups.about: Lucerne-based startup producing HILAYA, a traceable natural fibre from Himalayan nettle, as a lower-water alternative to cotton and synthetics for spinners and nonwoven producers.

startups.name: NRGY One AG
startups.about: Aarberg (BE) company, formed in 2026 from Siima Solution GmbH, that develops and operates energy-related software, systems and devices and trades energy products and services.

startups.name: Okidooki AG
startups.about: Basel-based company building and operating digital platforms and apps, focused on crypto, blockchain, AI and visual technologies.

startups.name: OOMNIUM AG
startups.about: Zurich-based crowd-investing platform that lets private investors invest directly in Swiss startups and SMEs, and supports companies running private or open funding rounds.

startups.name: OPINSTAR (ORGANICER GMBH)
startups.about: Review-management service helping businesses collect more Google reviews, improve visibility in Google and AI search, and answer reviews with automated AI responses.

startups.name: Philip Morris
startups.about: Philip Morris International, a multinational tobacco company with major Swiss operations in Lausanne and Neuchatel, developing smoke-free products such as heated tobacco and nicotine pouches.

startups.name: Rezid GmbH
startups.about: Rapperswil SG company developing a digital platform for social networking and collaboration, with software for individuals, companies and organisations covering communication, project management and data protection.

startups.name: Rilemo
startups.about: Italian medtech startup developing a portable, non-ionising electromagnetic imaging device for rapid bedside detection of stroke, brain bleeding and other fluid-related conditions in emergency and neurological care.

startups.name: Room4U
startups.about: Room4U AG in Elsau near Winterthur rents out storage rooms, private offices, coworking desks and virtual offices on flexible terms, including ready-to-use space for founders.

startups.name: RUAG
startups.about: Swiss state-owned defence and aerospace technology company that maintains, repairs and upgrades military systems as technology partner of the Swiss Armed Forces.

startups.name: Sedax
startups.about: Engineering firm in Uster that develops, manufactures and assembles mechanical and mechatronic systems and custom automation solutions, together with sister company August Manser AG.

startups.name: Sencare
startups.about: Milan-based healthtech startup with a cloud platform that helps care cooperatives, pharmacies and healthcare organisations organise and manage home-care services; reportedly also active in Switzerland.

startups.name: SentiaNova
startups.about: Zurich foodtech startup with a patented pre-processing step that removes bitter, beany off-flavours from pea and other pulse proteins, licensed to existing protein manufacturers.

startups.name: SeQure AG
startups.about: IT services company based in Baar (Zug), incorporated in 2025; no product details found.

startups.name: SICTIC
startups.about: Zurich-based non-profit angel investor club (Swiss ICT Investor Club) connecting early-stage Swiss tech startups with business angels and investors for pre-seed and seed financing rounds.

startups.name: Solcept
startups.about: Swiss engineering company developing embedded electronics and software for industrial, medical and other customers.

startups.name: Swiss Food & Nutrition Valley
startups.about: Swiss non-profit association that connects startups, corporates, universities, investors and public bodies to foster innovation in food, nutrition and agriculture.

startups.name: Swiss Life
startups.about: Swiss life insurance and pensions group offering life insurance, retirement planning, pension solutions and asset management to private and corporate clients.

startups.name: Swiss Startup Association (SSA)
startups.about: Non-profit association that represents the interests of Swiss startups and founders in politics and public debate and offers networking and services to its members.

startups.name: Swiss21.org AG
startups.about: Swiss provider of free cloud business software for SMEs and startups, covering accounting, invoicing and related administration.

startups.name: Talent Kick
startups.about: Free cross-university entrepreneurship programme run by the Kick Foundation that helps students at Swiss universities find co-founders, get mentoring and training, and build a startup while studying.

startups.name: Taler Operations AG
startups.about: Biel-based company that operates the GNU Taler privacy-preserving digital payment system in Swiss francs for individuals and businesses in Switzerland.

startups.name: TD Synnex
startups.about: Global IT distributor and solutions aggregator supplying hardware, software and cloud services to resellers, system integrators and service providers.

startups.name: Technopark Winterthur
startups.about: Public-private technology centre in Winterthur offering office and lab space, coworking and startup support, including the Runway Incubator, alongside ZHAW research institutes and established firms.

startups.name: Tethys Robotics
startups.about: ETH Zurich spin-off building compact autonomous underwater robots (Tethys ONE) for inspecting subsea infrastructure such as hydropower plants, cables and pipelines, and for search and recovery missions.

startups.name: Thermal Transformer
startups.about: Develops heat-driven adsorption chillers that turn low-grade waste heat from data centres and industrial processes into cooling. Supported by Innosuisse, Klimastiftung Schweiz and Startfeld.

startups.name: UBS
startups.about: Swiss-headquartered global bank and wealth manager offering wealth management, personal and corporate banking, asset management and investment banking.

startups.name: Upwater AG
startups.about: Eawag spin-off from Dübendorf that monitors wastewater treatment plants: measuring greenhouse gas and oxygen emissions, optimising aeration energy use and analysing sludge microbiomes via DNA sequencing.

startups.name: Vantyx
startups.about: Possible match: pre-seed software company from Vimercate, Italy, building AI-based tools to digitise business processes. Link to the Startup Nights exhibitor not confirmed.

startups.name: Venture
startups.about: Swiss startup competition co-organised by ETH Zurich and McKinsey since 1997, giving early-stage founders cash prizes, consulting support and expert mentoring.

startups.name: Venture Robot Solutions
startups.about: Zurich-based robotics startup developing and validating socially aware service robots for healthcare and elderly care.

startups.name: VRENI
startups.about: Zurich-developed voice companion for people with dementia that plays personal stories and familiar music at the press of a button, aimed at families and care institutions.

startups.name: Walder Wyss
startups.about: Swiss business law firm with offices in several Swiss cities, advising companies, startups and investors on corporate, M&A, financing, tax, IP and regulatory matters.

startups.name: WasteFlow
startups.about: EPFL spin-off from Lausanne providing AI vision systems for recycling and sorting facilities that identify and measure waste streams in real time to improve sorting efficiency.

startups.name: Wenger Vieli
startups.about: Zurich business law firm founded in 1971, with an office in Zug, advising on corporate and M&A, banking and fintech, tax, IP, data protection and litigation.

startups.name: whatwatt AG
startups.about: Swiss company making whatwatt Go, an adapter that reads household smart meters and delivers live electricity consumption and solar production data to apps and smart-home systems.

startups.name: Winduction AG
startups.about: ETH Zurich spin-off developing wireless charging for electric buses, transferring power from plates in the road to receiver coils in the wheels so buses can recharge at stops.

startups.name: Winti Ventures
startups.about: Winterthur-based investor club founded in 2022 that holds regular pitch events connecting early-stage startups with business angels and venture capitalists.

startups.name: YES
startups.about: Young Enterprise Switzerland, a non-profit running practical business education for Swiss school students, including the Company Programme in which students found and run their own mini-companies.

startups.name: Zelsius AG
startups.about: HSLU spin-off from Root (Lucerne) offering carbon-management software that helps Swiss industrial SMEs calculate corporate and product carbon footprints and prepare climate reports.

startups.name: Zenplify AG
startups.about: Lausanne-registered company (Zenplify SA) whose registered purpose is software development and distribution, plus related training and consulting services. Product not verified.

startups.name: ZHAW
startups.about: Zurich University of Applied Sciences, headquartered in Winterthur, offering degree programmes, applied research and support for student and researcher startups.
